data.notes: It catches all three must-catches: it cuts the acceptance-rate claim for $38 bookings, answers 'what do we lose' on PayPal/Venmo and saved cards, and uses 'sitter pay' and 'paid by Friday'. It also correctly treats the Braintree theory as the AE's guess and names the weekend prototype as the real reason. It misses the CFO's one finance line on when sitters get paid (it says 'not finance' instead), leaves the clear PayPal/Venmo answer out of missing proof, and skips the incumbent's account-manager churn and keeping marketplace onboarding in the message.
